reviews.title: A narrower policy interval can be more confidently wrong

reviews.title: Panel data: heterogeneity, timing and structural moments
reviews.review_scope: Complete assembled source-context reading; unchanged manuscript. Not a new rendered/visual review or independent correctness certification.
findings: Complete643-line panel argument read: FE/RE/correlated effects, short-panel dynamics, valid lag timing, ATT/DiD/negative TWFE weights, factors, dependence, system moments and selected donor/conformal inference.

Moment validity, initial-law restrictions, estimated normalizers/cohort weights and common-clock covariance are explicitly derived. Original finite-sample GMM correction remains uninspected, a consequential named source gap rather than merely an implementation task.

reviews.title: Time series, structural shocks and observation frequency
reviews.review_scope: Complete assembled source-context reading; unchanged manuscript. Not a new rendered/visual review or independent correctness certification.
findings: Complete1108-line time-series argument read: shock meaning, rotation/aliasing, external-IV exclusions, finite/infinite representations, dependent scores, Gaussian CLT/HAC, weak sets, nuisance separation, persistence and money.

All observed undercoverage, weak/unbounded sets and invalid-instrument failures remain. Reduced-form lag augmentation is distinct from normalized structural IV. Mathematical/prospective information and source-specific assumptions remain explicit.
